page.overview:
What is Sweet Little Sixteen?

Sweet Little Sixteen is a song written by Chuck Berry. The Beatles covered it Live At The BBC on July 10,1963. It was released on December 5,1994 in the US and November 30,1994 on the Beatles Live At the BBC Album.
